item.title: Re: What were the other SCPs involved in MTF Omega 7 Pandora
item.content:encoded: Seems like there are no other humanoid SCP there. That’s a shame. I thought I could find out what other humanoid SCP were were on the team.

item.title: Re: What were the other SCPs involved in MTF Omega 7 Pandora
item.content:encoded:
I'm not 100% sure here, but I think the rest of them and the stories (if there were stories) were either deleted in the Mass Edit of '09 or were later downvoted into deletion.

From what little I remember of that from '10, they were really bad and usually boring. I think given the 076 retcon (Also way back when ), only 076 and 105 are canon, but there were separate programs that also get covered in the Resurrection canon.

Maybe someone has an archive somewhere. Edit: http://scpclassic.wikidot.com/
You can search for Omega there and get some stuff.

item.title: What were the other SCPs involved in MTF Omega 7 Pandora
item.content:encoded:
I know 105 (Iris) and 076 (Able) are a part of it. But who else was? I know most them were Mary Sue s and that discontinued. But that’s pretty much it.

Also, what happened to stories involving them?
